test_title: PYST 44: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - Mathematics (Held On: 23 Jun, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: maths
question: At what rate (in percentage) per annum will ₹1,400 give ₹700 as simple interest in 5 years?
solution:
**Given:**

Principal (P) = ₹1,400

Simple Interest (SI) = ₹700

Time (T) = 5 years

**Formula Used:**

Rate (R) = (SI × 100) / (P × T)

**Calculation:**

R = (700 × 100) / (1400 × 5)

⇒ R = 70000 / 7000

⇒ R = 10%

**The rate of interest per annum is 10%.**
